title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Friday, 25 September 2026
description: Today: Anthropic's Claude autonomously discovers a novel bacteriophage enzyme system as a voluntary Frontier AI Standards Agency takes shape; Lachie Neale is cleared to play Saturday's AFL grand final after his ban is overturned; Queensland's Premier pitches a 'next generation economy' at the National Press Club; and Gold Coast rail commuters face weeks more bus replacements. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
